_note: Returns a historical version of a workflow. Different schema from the main workflow object — no settings, tags, or shared data. Has authors and description instead.
name: CRM Sync Pipeline
description: Syncs closed deals from Salesforce to Slack and Google Sheets

_business_value.change_tracking: Compare versions to detect what changed. New nodes added? Connections modified? Parameters updated? This is drift detection.
_business_value.authorship: Who made this version — shows who actively maintains each workflow. Better than just 'owner'.
_business_value.description: User-written workflow description — free context for the LLM if available.
_business_value.priority_for_demo: Low. Version history is governance depth, not business opportunity. Park for future.
